name: sagemath-mcp
description: Stateful SageMath computations: symbolic calculus, number theory, linear algebra, graphs, groups, elliptic curves, plotting and claim verification.
long_description:
Gives the model a sandboxed mathematical subset of SageMath through 40 tools. Each session gets its own Sage worker, so variables, functions and assumptions persist across tool calls. Caller code is deny-by-default: the breadth of Sage mathematics is reachable, but imports, external computer-algebra interfaces and the file, display and persistence primitives are not.

The Sage runtime comes from the passagemath distribution and is installed on first launch. That download is roughly 1 GB, so the first start is slow and needs a working network connection; later starts are immediate. For untrusted or multi-tenant use, run the hardened container instead of this bundle: a local install has your user's privileges, while the container adds operating-system isolation.
